    Questions

    Can the size be changed?

    Yes, we adapt models to the project. Send the room dimensions on WhatsApp.

    Can you make it from my sketch?

    Yes, we make bespoke pieces. Send a sketch or a photo.

    What mechanisms are there?

    Fold-out — for sofas, lift-up — for beds. We match one to your model.

    How much does it cost?

    It depends on the model, size and upholstery. We quote on WhatsApp: send a photo or a request from the cart.

    What are the lead times?

    We name them once the project is approved and the fabric is chosen.

    Delivery and warranty?

    We deliver across Kazakhstan; for other countries — lead times and cost are quoted for your address. Warranty — 5 years.
